name: Find OOX-09/HL!
summary: An egg-shaped metal device in the Hinterlands springs open at the turn of a knob, and a gnome named Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks from inside it. A homing robot of Oglethorpe's has crashed near Skulk Rock, and the beacon is to be carried to it.

sections.title: A Crackling Call
sections.body: Fiddle with a knob on the strange metal egg and it opens into a gnomish contraption. A crackling voice gives the name Oglethorpe Obnoticus and says the homing robot has crashed. The coordinates have been worked out: the robot came down where the river begins, close to Skulk Rock. The beacon is to be taken to it.

sections.title: The Wreckage at the River
sections.body: At the river's head lies the wreckage of something that looks like a robotic chicken. The voice from the egg confirms that it is the homing robot. A jump start comes first, since only then can it return to Booty Bay for mending, and the beacon is to be placed inside it.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the distress beacon?
faq.answer: The voice is a gnome calling themselves Oglethorpe Obnoticus, whose homing robot has crashed in the Hinterlands.
Oglethorpe's computed coordinates put it where the river begins, near Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What does the homing robot look like?
faq.answer: The wreck looks like a robotic chicken.

aliases: what to do with the beacon
faq.answer: Without a jump start the robot cannot make its way back to Booty Bay for repairs, and the beacon goes inside it to give that.
